In occupied Oleshky, Melania Trump negotiated a local cease-fire that has reduced fighting, and a separate cease-fire was also agreed for the town. Ukraine reports that Starlink speed restrictions remain despite promises to restore service. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. approved.en: Sudanese armed forces have continued drone strikes on markets in the disputed Abyei border region, killing more than 150 people in each attack. Communal clashes persist, with SSPDF and SPLA-IO forces fighting in Kapoeta North, Eastern Equatoria, and in Wij-Panyikang, Upper Nile, while a separate ambush killed two people in Kajo-Keji County. Monitors warned of rising violence ahead of December elections and reported 40,000 people displaced by renewed Upper Nile fighting. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Observatører advarte om økende vold før desembervalg og rapporterte at 40 000 personer er fordrevet på grunn av fornyet kamp i Øvre Nilen. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The European Union has expanded migration cooperation with eastern Libya, and China has called for an end to Libya’s political deadlock. approved.en: The United States has revived a rarely used torture indictment against Maduro for ordering torture of rivals and has deployed Space Force electromagnetic and electronic warfare systems against Venezuela while pressuring Reliance to refine Venezuelan oil. Opposition groups are staging nationwide protests demanding elections and the return of Machado, and a Dutch security report warns that Venezuela’s instability could threaten Curaçao and the wider Caribbean Kingdom. The Pentagon has issued a directive banning DoD personnel from using nonpublic information to bet on U.S. military operations, including those involving Venezuela. The U.S. Embassy has reopened in Venezuela to full staff, according to NBC News, and 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2007, according to UCDP.

Opposisjonsgrupper holder landsomfattende protester som krever valg og at Machado kommer tilbake, og en nederlandsk sikkerhetsrapport advarer om at Venezuelas ustabilitet kan true Curaçao og det bredere Karibiske kongeriket. Pentagon har gitt en direktiv som forbyr DoD-personell å bruke ikke-offentlig informasjon til å satse på amerikanske militæroperasjoner, inkludert de som involverer Venezuela. Den amerikanske ambassaden har gjenåpnet i Venezuela med fullt personale, ifølge NBC News, og to dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
